reports.title: EDP Notification Tables (Government Deficit and Debt)
reports.description: Harmonised tables in which EU Member States report their planned and actual government deficit and debt levels to Eurostat under the excessive deficit procedure (EDP). Council Regulation (EC) No 479/2009, Article 3(1): 'Member States shall report to the Commission (Eurostat) their planned and actual government deficits and levels of government debt twice a year, the first time before 1 April of the current year (year n) and the second time before 1 October of year n.' Eurostat's own page: 'In April and October of each year, Eurostat publishes the notification tables as transmitted by EU Member States in accordance with EU regulation 479/2009.'
reports.cadence_note: Live-verified against both the Regulation text and the Eurostat page's own current release listing -- 'April 2026' and 'October 2025' dated release blocks visible on the live page.

entries.covers: October 2026 EDP notification (government deficit and debt data)

release_schedule.note: Eurostat's April 2026 EDP notification press release (22 April 2026) explicitly states 'Next release: 21 October 2026' for the following EDP notification. This matches the publisher's stated pattern that EDP notification tables are published in April and October each year, per Council Regulation 479/2009 which requires Member States to report EDP data at end of March and end of September. The April 2026 release has already occurred, so the next expected release is the confirmed 21 October 2026 date.

reports.title: Report on the Quality of Fiscal Data Reported by EU Member States
reports.description: Article 8(3) of Council Regulation (EC) No 479/2009 (as amended): 'The Commission (Eurostat) shall report regularly to the European Parliament and to the Council on the quality of the actual data reported by Member States.' Eurostat's own page characterizes the resulting output as annual reports and currently lists 'Staff working document reporting to the European Parliament and the Council on the quality of fiscal data reported by Member States (MS) in 2025'. Note: the Regulation's own text says 'regularly', not 'annually' -- the annual framing is Eurostat's own practice, not a statutory requirement.
reports.cadence_note: Live-verified on Eurostat's own quality page; current edition assesses 2025 data. Statutory basis says 'regularly', not 'annually' -- recorded as a distinction, not resolved.

entries.covers: Quality of fiscal data reported by Member States in 2022
Quality of fiscal data reported by Member States in 2024
Quality of fiscal data reported by Member States in 2025
Quality of fiscal data reported by Member States in 2026 (projected next edition)

release_schedule.note: Council Regulation (EC) No 479/2009 (as amended) requires the Commission (Eurostat) to report 'regularly' -- not on a fixed statutory date -- to the European Parliament and Council on fiscal data quality. In practice, Commission Staff Working Documents in this series have been transmitted to the Council each year in April: SWD covering 2022 data was dated/received ~14-18 April 2023 (Council doc ST-8410-2023-INIT); SWD covering 2024 data was dated 30 April 2025 (ST-8500-2025-INIT); SWD(2026)127 final covering 2025 data was dated 28 April 2026 and transmitted to Council 20 May 2026 (ST-8895-2026-INIT). This confirms the corpus's existing cadence_note: the statutory language is 'regularly,' not a fixed annual mandate, but observed practice has been one edition per year, released in April. Since the 2025-data edition already appeared in April 2026, the next expected edition (covering 2026 data) would be around April 2027.

reports.title: MFI Balance Sheet Items (BSI) Statistics
reports.publisher: European Central Bank (ECB) / National Central Banks (NCBs)
reports.description: ECB's own methodology page: 'Monetary financial institution (MFI) balance sheet items (BSI) statistics are compiled by the ECB and include monthly and quarterly data.' All MFIs in the euro area are legally obliged to report to their national central bank, which in turn reports national aggregates to the ECB. Governed by Regulation ECB/2021/2 (recast) and Guideline ECB/2021/11.
reports.cadence_note: Live-verified on the ECB's own methodology page -- monthly data, with further breakdowns available quarterly.

release_schedule.note: ECB publishes a dedicated statistical release calendar page for the MFI aggregated balance sheet (BSI) with dated releases at 10:00 CET each month, roughly 4 weeks after month-end (slightly longer over year-end). The 27 July 2026 release (June 2026 data) has already passed relative to today (2026-08-11); the next release is 27 August 2026.

reports.title: Consolidated Banking Data (CBD2)
reports.publisher: European Central Bank (ECB) / National Central Banks (NCBs)
reports.description: Aggregate consolidated profitability, balance sheets, asset quality, liquidity, funding, capital adequacy and solvency data for EU banks by size group, built from European Banking Authority Implementing Technical Standards (FINREP/COREP) supervisory reporting. Governed by Guideline ECB/2021/14.
reports.cadence_note: UNRESOLVED CONFLICT, recorded as found: the ECB's own live methodology page states, in one place, 'Data are published four times a year' and, further down the same page, 'The data are semi-annual, except for certain detailed breakdowns which are collected only annually.' Both sentences confirmed present on the live page 2026-08-05. releases_per_year uses the figure stated first and most prominently; not adjudicated. See EU/ECB-Staging-Batches_PartA_2026-08-05.md.

entries.covers: CBD2 Q2 2026 consolidated banking data (release incl. press release)

release_schedule.note: ECB's own statistics release calendar page for Consolidated Banking Data (dataset CBD2) lists dated releases: 07/08/2026 (already occurred — confirmed by press release published 2026-08-07 covering end-March 2026/Q1 2026 data) and 06/11/2026, both marked 'Tentative,' each 'Includes press release.' Prior actual press releases confirm a quarterly cadence: end-June 2025 data published 2025-11-21; end-September 2025 data published 2026-02-13; end-December 2025 data published 2026-06-19; end-March 2026 data published 2026-08-07. This supports releases_per_year=4 (one release per calendar quarter's reference data), consistent with the 'four times a year' statement on the methodology page, though the lag between reference quarter-end and publication varies (roughly 4-5 months) and the methodology page separately notes underlying data collection is semi-annual/annual for some breakdowns — that conflict (already flagged in the existing cadence_note) concerns data collection frequency, not the release/publication frequency, which the calendar clearly shows as quarterly.

reports.title: Supervisory Banking Statistics (SUP)
reports.publisher: European Central Bank (ECB) / National Central Banks (NCBs)
reports.description: Aggregate prudential data on significant institutions under ECB Banking Supervision — capital, leverage, liquidity, asset quality and profitability — built from European Banking Authority Implementing Technical Standards (FINREP/COREP) supervisory reporting, on the same institutional basis as ecb-consolidated-banking-data. Legal basis: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/451 (ITS on supervisory reporting), ECB Regulation ECB/2015/13, Council Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013 (SSM Regulation) and Directive 2013/36/EU (CRD IV).
reports.cadence_note: ECB Data Portal, checked live 2026-08-08: 'The supervisory banking dataset is updated on a quarterly basis. With each update of the database figures for the previous four quarters can also be revised, as banks may resubmit data.' Note some general-government exposure breakdowns are collected only semi-annually, not the whole dataset — flagged, not adjudicated, same shape as the CBD2 conflict on the sibling node. Named but not minted since G.39.md/this file's original drafting for lack of a cadence statement; resolved 2026-08-08 by checking the live page.

release_schedule.note: ECB Banking Supervision press releases show a consistent quarterly cadence of roughly 2.5-2.7 months after quarter-end: Q3 2025 data published 2025-12-17, Q4 2025 data published 2026-03-18, Q1 2026 data published 2026-06-19. No formal dated release calendar was found (the ECB statistical calendar page does not list SUP-specific dates), so exact day-of-month for upcoming releases is inferred from this pattern rather than documented. This is consistent with the existing cadence_note describing quarterly updates to the underlying dataset; the press-release cadence and dataset-update cadence appear aligned.

reports.title: Insurance Corporations Operations (ICO)
reports.publisher: European Central Bank (ECB) / National Central Banks (NCBs)
reports.description: Euro area insurance corporations' transactions, revaluations and other flows (premiums, claims, technical reserves and related operations), companion series to the insurance corporations' balance-sheet statistics. Legal basis: ECB Regulation ECB/2014/50 (reporting requirements and exemptions for insurance corporations) and Guideline ECB/2021/12 on financial intermediaries other than monetary financial institutions.
reports.cadence_note: ECB Data Portal, checked live 2026-08-08: metadata states 'Time period: Annual' and 'Frequency of data collection: Annual.' Named but not minted since this file's original drafting for lack of a cadence statement; resolved 2026-08-08 by checking the live page. Domain retagged insurance 2026-08-08 (Thomas, OPEN-THREADS 0.5) — previously filed under financial-regulation for want of a dedicated tag.

release_schedule.note: ECB Data Portal metadata for ICO labels 'Time period: Annual' / 'Frequency of data collection: Annual', but this is a collection-frequency label, not a dated release calendar or stated publication rule. The ICO data-information page says 'See the release calendar for insurance corporations statistics in the euro area on the ECB's website,' but the only such calendar found (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/statscal/mfm/html/sticb.ga.html, entries for 26 Aug 2026 / 26 Nov 2026 / 26 Feb 2027) is explicitly for the quarterly Insurance Corporations Balance Sheet (ICB) dataset, not for ICO. No separate ICO calendar page could be located, and the compilation guide and reporting-framework pages state no fixed timeliness rule (e.g. 'within X months of year-end') for ICO specifically. The ICO dataset page shows 'Dataset last updated: 5 May 2026 10:00 CEST' (a single data point, insufficient to establish a recurring month-of-year pattern). Given no calendar, no stated computable rule, and no corroborated multi-year pattern, classified as irregular.

reports.title: Investment Funds Balance Sheet Statistics (IVF)
reports.publisher: European Central Bank (ECB) / National Central Banks (NCBs)
reports.description: Euro area investment funds' assets and liabilities by investment policy and type (equity, bond, mixed, real estate, hedge and other funds), reported by NCBs and aggregated by the ECB. Legal basis: Regulation (EU) No 1073/2013 (ECB/2013/38) concerning statistics on the assets and liabilities of investment funds, and Guideline ECB/2014/15 on monetary and financial statistics, which sets NCB reporting procedures.
reports.cadence_note: ECB Data Portal, checked live 2026-08-08: 'Time period: Monthly, except for certain detailed breakdowns which are collected quarterly' and 'Frequency of data collection: Monthly and quarterly.' releases_per_year uses the monthly headline balance-sheet series; the quarterly sub-breakdowns are a more granular secondary tier, not a second nodeable series, same treatment as CBD2's semi-annual detail breakdowns on a sibling node. Named but not minted since this file's original drafting for lack of a cadence statement; resolved 2026-08-08 by checking the live page.

release_schedule.note: Dates from the ECB's official statistics release calendar for investment fund statistics (dataset IVF), all scheduled 10:00 CET. This confirms the monthly cadence: releases occur roughly every month, ~7 weeks after the reference period ends, consistent with the existing releases_per_year=12 and cadence_note. Quarterly sub-breakdowns are published alongside the monthly release for the relevant quarter-end months (Q2, Q3, Q4 shown above), not as a separate release event.

CADENCE NOW WELL-EVIDENCED, STILL NOT MINTED, 2026-08-09 (sweep session, Tier-2 item #9, no-document review) — the European Commission's own Alert Mechanism Report page (economy-finance.ec.europa.eu) describes it directly: 'a document issued by the European Commission towards the end of the calendar year, in conjunction with the annual growth survey,' calling it 'the starting point of the annual cycle of the Macroeconomic Imbalance Procedure,' with dated editions listed back to 2012 and three recent ones confirmed live (November 2025, December 2024, November 2023). This clears Research.1.md §4's cadence condition on its own terms (demonstrated recurrence, not merely a news mention) — the original 'not itself a cadence statement' objection no longer holds. STILL NOT MINTED, because the original lead never stated what edge the AMR/MIP scoreboard would actually serve — no document read by this session's predecessor or this session names it as an input to, or output of, anything else in this file's material, and minting a node with no proposed edge context risks an ungrounded isolated addition rather than a finding.
